# Content and launch resource

## EN3 content inventory
Main navigation: discovery, Journal, My tickets, For partners. Experiences: Bandipur Tiger Reserve and Veda Nāda. Bandipur includes safari booking, about, and organiser policies. Veda Nāda includes its story, artist profile, previous concert, and organiser policies. Five journal stories and six platform policy/contact pages are preserved.

## Content to keep current
- Organiser logos, taglines, experience photos, dates, time windows, seating rules and booking cutoffs.
- Current vehicle capacities, adult/child limits, rates and cancellation slabs.
- Partner fees, sell-out conditions, applicable taxes and settlement schedule.
- Legal entity, support contact, and approved policy versions.
- Accurate image descriptions and photographer/media permissions.

## Before a production launch
- Replace captured event availability with current data and verify timezone handling in Asia/Kolkata.
- Keep one canonical production origin; this isolated preview stays noindex,nofollow.
- Review title, description, social image, canonical URL, and Event/Organization structured data for every route.
- Add an XML sitemap and robots rules for the final production routes.
- Check keyboard navigation, visible focus, form labels, error announcements, contrast, reduced motion, and phone layouts.
- Use responsive images and modern formats; keep font loading local and avoid blocking third-party resources.
- Confirm policy wording, refunds, privacy notices, consent, and support handling with the site's responsible owner.
- Test sold-out, no-inventory, failed-payment, duplicate-callback, expired-hold, refund and network-error paths before enabling live transactions.

These are implementation resources, not a claim that the captured public website exposes its private services or satisfies any legal requirement.
